description: Image Description: The image shows a pastoral scene featuring several brown horses grazing in a lush, green field. The foreground contains four horses with their heads down, eating grass. The field is surrounded by a dense forest of tall trees with rich green foliage, suggesting a natural and serene environment. The lighting is warm, indicating that the image may have been taken during the golden hour, either in the morning or late afternoon. The scene conveys a sense of tranquility and natural beauty.
